note: Leads L1.5-a — no silent loss on the provider edge (email hint kept whole or dropped, CloudTalk outage vs signature, Wix unparsable order not acknowledged). Stale-receipt health is pinned in lib/intake/sweep-health.test.ts (leads-l1.json); the DB halves run in the .m6 / .m7bc batteries.

lib/intake/l15a-silent-refusal.test.ts.reason: L1.5-a lead-loss integrity: an email longer than a Lead may hold is dropped instead of dead-lettering the lead or being cut into another address; CloudTalk answers 503 (redelivered) when its secrets cannot be read instead of a false invalid_signature; Wix's unparsable signed order is answered 400 so Wix resends it instead of a silent 200

lib/intake/l15a-hold-gate.test.ts.reason: L1.5-a lead-loss integrity: only the platform emergency switch holds (records, never processes until released); a withdrawn entitlement or quarantine records nothing; every lead / commerce / telephony adapter re-checks the gate after the revoked check and before provider work, as a deferral that spends no attempt and deletes nothing; held receipts are a visible count

lib/intake/l15a-paused-hold.test.ts.reason: L1.5-a decision 3 lead-loss integrity: the seven intake sources resolve through the v2 lookups so a PAUSED endpoint still verifies and records (held, never processed, never dropped); revoked stays IGNORED and is checked first, a withdrawn entitlement or quarantine still records nothing; resuming re-arms only that connection's paused receipts; Rivhit keeps v1

lib/intake/l15b-fair-queue.test.ts.reason: L1.5-b PR-1 lead-loss integrity: held receipts never take a drain's whole budget (each lane keeps a fifth; ready work first, fair by source; held fair by connection); both lanes list exactly the claimable due set in UTC; one look settles only its own business / source / connection's due held receipts, spends no attempt, never touches a live lease; only the hydrate hold branch does it

lib/intake/l15b-release.test.ts.reason: L1.5-b PR-5 lead-loss integrity: the sweep never starts a business past its budget and rotates its start so none is always last; release rounds go only to businesses that moved work forward, bounded and drain-only; a resume flips the status in its transaction and re-arms receipts afterwards in bounded batches, never a receipt under a live lease, best effort (the hold recheck releases the rest); health stamping bounded per run

lib/intake/l15b-capacity.test.ts.reason: L1.5-b PR-2 lead-loss + privacy integrity: capacity thresholds (500/1,000/2,000 per business, 20,000 platform) are monitoring only and never refuse a delivery; backlog / flow reads are bounded (row cap + server statement timeout), read-only, open backlog only, select no payload or person field, run under the business RLS; the sweep reads them best effort after its own work; new red reasons exist only with INTAKE_CAPACITY_ALERTS_ENABLED=true, each tier crossing reported once

lib/business-status/intake-attention.tes.reason: L1.5-b PR-3 privacy + honesty: the owner intake status shows counts only (no name, phone, message, endpoint id, key or provider code), never presents a waiting enquiry as a lead or counts it in the leads badge, scopes to the business own connections, is gated by intake_status_visibility (OFF by default, fail-open) and reads a bounded, cached backlog; the connections API adds waiting counts only when the gate answered

lib/notifications/intake-notifications.v.reason: L1.5-b PR-4 owner notifications about lead intake: in-app only or silent (no leads rule grants push), info / warning / action told apart, one dedupe fact per situation, resolution only after a complete read, gated by intake_status_visibility, never throws, no enquiry content
